verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live, versioned production REST API platform with a structured error contract, and Making Tax Digital routes Income Tax quarterly updates and filing through compatible software, so core filing has an API path. However, several UI journeys are documented only as online services or the business tax account, with no API equivalent shown: MTD sign-up, VAT registration and exemption, employer registration, and Corporation Tax management. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for registration and sign-up flows (VAT, PAYE employer, MTD enrolment), API parity for Corporation Tax account management, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of API scope versus the UI.
